newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee coop stocks 2.07 mln bags in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee coop stocks 2.07 mln bags in Feb.

text.p: Coffee stocks held by Brazilian cooperatives totalled 2.07 million 60.5 kg bags on February 28, the National Coffee Council (CNC) said in a statement.
This is down from than the 2.63 million bags held by cooperatives as of January 31 and also below the 2.16 million bags held at the same stage in 1996.
The fact stocks are lower at this stage than last year when producers were working with the frost and drought-hit 1995/96 crop shows the higher level of sales by producers, the CNC said.

Sales by cooperatives reached 748,812 bags in February versus 720,579 bags during January and 324,734 bags in February last year, showing that producers maintained the flow of coffee to the market, the CNC said.
Cooperatives received 182,287 bags of coffee during the month of February, almost exactly twice the 89,271 bags delivered in February 1996, it added.
((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
